text: Property Rental APP is a dynamic mobile application that simplifies the apartment rental process in the US market. It connects tenants and listers, allowing listers to list their properties and tenants to search, filter, and apply for apartments. Pelicans Technologies was chosen for our expertise in building scalable, user-friendly mobile solutions that simplify complex workflows and deliver seamless digital experiences.

Features include property search with filters (location, rent, rooms, etc.), apartment videos, property tours, background checks, document sharing, contact signatures, and secure payments for deposits and rent.

items: Handling Large Listings: The application needed to handle thousands of apartment listings displayed on a map, causing significant system lag.
Managing Video Playback and Memory: Efficient video management was crucial for smooth playback, without overwhelming the system’s memory.
Real-Time Data Integration: Incorporating real-world, up-to-date apartment data posed a challenge in providing accurate, live listings to users.

AI Chat bot: The chat feature needed to filter and provide accurate apartment listings based on user input. Implementing real-time chat functionality that could query the database and return the best results was a challenge via AI

We restricted the number of apartment listings displayed on the map (100 to 250 per view) and implemented pagination. This, along with reusing existing views rather than generating new views each time, significantly improved performance.

To manage video playback, we optimized the video loading process by caching the first few seconds of the video for each apartment. If a user selects a video to view, the other videos in the listing would be pre-cached for smoother playback

To overcome the challenge of providing accurate data, we integrated third-party SDKs like IDX, which provided real-time apartment listing updates, ensuring that the app delivered the most current and relevant data to users.
Introduced automation tools to track guest interactions, enabling personalized experiences based on guest preferences, improving satisfaction and fostering loyalty.

We integrated an Open AI-powered chatbot that enabled tenants to interact and filter listings based on their preferences (location, price, number of rooms, etc.). This solution allowed users to get the best matches directly from the system, making the experience more personalized and efficient. Integrating the Open API was a significant learning experience that enhanced the app’s functionality
Advance listing and filters of apartments
Background check for tenant
Property tour booking & IDX scrapper
Apply for apartment digitally
Listing properties for rent
Apple subscription for listing apartments
Payment via stripe and apple pay
Mobile-friendly and visually engaging interface

text: The solution improved the app's performance and user experience by handling large data sets, integrating real-time info, and introducing a chatbot API for personalized tenant searches. The client was very satisfied, particularly with the seamless communication, collaboration, and resolution of performance issues.

A trailblazing neurotech brand, set out to empower individuals on their journey toward better mental well-being and peak cognitive performance. Their vision was to create a seamless platform that bridges neuroscience with everyday life making brain health more accessible, measurable, and actionable through state-of-the-art wearable EEG headbands.

Pelicans Technologies was entrusted with bringing this vision to life through a robust and intuitive digital ecosystem. Combining our expertise in connected hardware integration, data visualization, and user-centered design, we collaborated closely with Neuphony to develop an intelligent mobile app experience that transforms raw brainwave data into meaningful insights for users seeking mindfulness, focus, and emotional balance.

We crafted a clean, calming, and intuitive UI that supports platform mission of mental wellness. From effortless onboarding to real-time EEG feedback, every detail from color palette to layout was designed to minimize distraction and enhance focus. The result is a user-friendly experience even for those new to neurofeedback.

items: EEG data is technical by nature. Presenting it in a way that’s easy to understand for the average user without oversimplifying was a major design hurdle.
Ensuring seamless, uninterrupted Bluetooth connectivity between the mobile app and the EEG headband was critical to maintain real-time tracking.
Encouraging users to come back daily and track their mental health progress required habit-forming UX.
Handling and displaying live brain activity without delays demanded a robust and responsive system architecture.
We used clean graphs and intuitive performance metrics like focus scores and streaks to translate brain signals into actionable insights.
By leveraging native Bluetooth APIs and implementing reconnect logic, we ensured smooth pairing and real-time communication with the EEG headband.
Features like daily streaks, performance badges, and weekly comparison reports kept users motivated and engaged.
The design language stayed true to the app’s meditative core soft animations, soothing colors, and a minimalist interface helped reduce digital noise.
Users can visualize their brain waves in real-time during meditation sessions.
Guided exercises designed by neuroscientists to improve focus and cognitive wellness.
Detailed reports of focus scores, session durations, and performance trends.
Seamless connection between the app and platform's EEG headband for real-time feedback.
Users can compare their mental fitness trends week over week to see tangible improvements.
Tailored recommendations and tracking tools based on individual brain patterns.

text: Now a true wellness companion, the app empowers users to track brain activity, follow science-backed meditations, and monitor progress with ease. With a refined UX, improved retention, and simplified data visualization, This app makes mental training accessible and engaging for a wider audience.

items: With a wide variety of stainless steel grades, forms, and applications, structuring the content in a way that is both comprehensive and easy to navigate is a major challenge.

Implement a tiered navigation system with categories such as Product Type, Material Grade, Application, and Standards to help users drill down to the right product efficiently.
Create a dedicated resource center offering downloadable datasheets, test certificates, technical whitepapers, and FAQs to serve engineers and procurement professionals.
Highlight international clients, export destinations, and third-party inspection reports alongside ISO and ASTM certifications to reinforce credibility and global standards.
Integrate dynamic tools such as quote request forms, product filtering, and a client portal for repeat customers to improve the user experience and drive conversions.

text: By addressing these challenges with strategic solutions and integrating user-focused features, Sachin Steel’s website effectively meets the needs of industrial buyers, engineers, and global partners—enhancing user experience, improving accessibility to technical information, and reinforcing the company’s position as a trusted leader in the stainless steel industry.

Opera Colorado, a premier performing arts organization dedicated to delivering world-class opera experiences, required a modern, immersive digital platform that could reflect the elegance of its productions while serving a diverse and growing audience. The organization needed an intuitive event discovery system, seamless ticketing integration, and a visually rich interface to engage patrons, donors, educators, and newcomers alike.

Pelicans Technologies was chosen for our proven expertise in building high-impact digital solutions that amplify cultural engagement, enhance usability, and support long-term growth. We crafted a refined, responsive website that captures the spirit of opera while streamlining key user journeys—from purchasing tickets to exploring educational programs—ensuring Opera Colorado’s digital presence is as powerful and inspiring as its performances.
After revamping the UI, user engagement skyrocketed, and we saw a big drop in bounce rate. Interactive features and a fun, engaging design kept users around longer, sparking deeper interactions.

items: The website must serve multiple user groups—opera patrons, donors, educators, students, press, and first-time attendees—each seeking different types of content and experiences.
Managing performances, events, and season schedules with multiple venues, dates, and ticket tiers requires a robust and dynamic events system.
A frictionless user journey from discovery to purchase or donation is essential to support both revenue and philanthropic goals.
Opera is a rich multimedia experience. The website must effectively present videos, audio clips, high-res imagery, and artist bios to captivate and inform users.
Opera Colorado’s community and educational programs need clear visibility and easy access to resources for teachers, students, and parents.
The site must be fully responsive and accessible (ADA compliant) to ensure all users—including those with disabilities—can engage with content on any device.
Created dedicated sections or quick paths for specific user groups (e.g., “First-Time Attendees,” “Educators,” “Press,” “Subscribers”) to quickly find relevant information.
Used a seamless integration with a ticketing platform (e.g., Tessitura or similar) that supports calendar views, seat selection, subscription packages, and mobile ticketing.
Designed prominent and persistent CTAs (Call-To-Actions) for ticket purchasing and donations, paired with streamlined forms and one-click access to key user actions.
Implemented a rich media gallery showcasing trailers, behind-the-scenes footage, and artist interviews to immerse users in the operatic experience.
Built a resource hub that includes downloadable lesson plans, educational videos, outreach program information, and event registration for schools.
Ensured WCAG 2.1 compliance through alt text, keyboard navigation, color contrast standards, and screen reader compatibility—plus a mobile-first responsive layout.
A detailed, interactive calendar allows users to filter by production, venue, date, or type (performance, educational event, community outreach).
Secure donation forms with multiple giving options (one-time, recurring, in honor/memory, matching gifts) encourage philanthropic support.
Each production has its own landing page with cast bios, synopsis, media, and direct ticket links, creating a compelling storytelling experience.
Easily accessible sign-up forms to grow Opera Colorado’s mailing list, integrated with email marketing tools like Mailchimp or Constant Contact.
Promote community involvement and staff recruitment through a dedicated page for current openings, volunteer programs, and internship opportunities.
A content-rich blog or news section provides updates, articles, artist spotlights, and behind-the-scenes stories to drive returning traffic and SEO.

text: The redevelopment of Opera Colorado’s website focused on overcoming key user experience and engagement challenges, resulting in a dynamic, accessible, and culturally rich digital platform. Pluckk, a modern brand redefining how consumers experience fresh, clean, and responsibly grown produce, needed a vibrant and scalable digital platform to support its mission. The goal was to create a compelling online experience one that communicated the brand’s freshness, enabled seamless shopping, and inspired trust in quality-conscious buyers.

Pelicans Technologies was chosen for our ability to craft intuitive eCommerce experiences that not only streamline operations and enhance engagement but also build a strong emotional connection between brand and customer.

Our revamped UI really made users feel more engaged, and we saw the bounce rate drop a lot. The mix of interactive elements and an attractive design kept users sticking around for longer and having deeper interactions.

items: Selling fruits and vegetables online isn’t easy customers can’t touch, smell, or inspect the produce. The biggest challenge was to make freshness feel real, right through a screen.
With produce shelf-life being short, the team needed a system that could update stock in real-time and avoid overselling or stockouts especially during peak demand hours.
Competing with big grocery apps and local vendors meant Pluckk had to clearly communicate its unique value: clean eating, traceability, and high-quality sourcing.
While the concept of “clean” and “residue-free” produce is powerful, it wasn’t something every customer understood. A platform was needed to not just sell but also educate.
Delivering fresh produce means getting things right every single day one bad experience can lose a customer. Aligning website orders with real-time logistics was critical.
Since most users shop on their phones, the mobile experience had to be ultra-smooth fast, responsive, and designed with everyday grocery shoppers in mind.
The website was designed to bring produce to life crisp images, clean layouts, and natural colors helped evoke trust and quality at first glance.
We built a custom inventory sync that tracks stock in real-time and shows only what’s available for a user’s location, reducing failed orders and refunds.
From banners to product pages, the site emphasizes Pluckk’s clean eating philosophy, transparent sourcing, and chemical-free produce setting it apart from the rest.
Integrated lifestyle tips, recipes, and “Did You Know?” facts throughout the experience to help users understand the value of what they’re buying.
Delivery slots were dynamically linked to backend logistics, so users always saw accurate timing and availability ensuring reliability with every order.
Developed a mobile-first interface with thumb-friendly controls, fast loading, and smooth navigation tailored for busy, everyday shoppers.
Users can shop by goals detox, weight management, immunity boosts making the experience more relevant and personalized.
Shoppers can explore healthy recipes and instantly add all ingredients to cart making clean eating not just aspirational, but practical.
The platform shows what’s available near each user, ensuring hyper-local freshness and timely delivery.
Repeat customers get tailored recommendations based on past orders, preferences, and trending items.
A dedicated area educates users about what “clean eating” means, with badges and stories from farms to the table.
Offers multiple payment options – UPI, cards, wallets and a secure, fuss-free checkout, whether on desktop or mobile.

text: The transition from a mobile-only platform to a responsive website was a significant success for Pluckk. By maintaining the app’s user experience and ensuring consistency across all devices, Pluckk was able to broaden its reach and improve overall customer satisfaction. The responsive website now stands as a vital part of Pluckk’s digital strategy, offering users the convenience of shopping from any device with a seamless and enjoyable experience.

Quik-E, a cutting-edge mobile repair platform, set out to redefine how people manage device breakdowns and damage with speed, transparency, and convenience. The brand needed a solution that streamlined service bookings, offered real-time repair tracking, and provided hassle-free doorstep pickup and drop-off—all while ensuring users felt confident entrusting their phones to a third party.

Pelicans Technologies was selected for our deep expertise in crafting intuitive digital platforms. We built a secure, mobile-first website enabling customers to select protection plans, schedule services with ease, and track every stage of their repair journey—all in one sleek, user-friendly experience.

The modernized UI resulted in higher user engagement and a significant decrease in the bounce rate. Interactive features and a captivating design held users’ attention, promoting longer visits and enhanced interactions.

items: Presenting a multi-step service (book, pick-up, repair, return) in a simple, intuitive format.
Majority of users access via mobile; required fast loading and optimized layout on smaller screens.
Convincing users to trust a third-party mobile repair service online.
Streamlining service plan selection, booking, and follow-up with minimal clicks and inputs.
Building a scalable backend for varied phone brands, conditions, and repair types.
Keeping users updated on service progress in a transparent and efficient way.
Clear visual breakdown of the four service stages improves understanding and builds confidence.
Mobile-optimized UI with compressed assets and fluid layouts for consistent performance across devices.
Real customer reviews with brand/issue/time saved info to build credibility.
Dropdown selectors for brand and phone condition guide users to relevant plans quickly.
Designed backend to handle multiple device types and statuses, integrated with CRM.
Clear call center number and promise of doorstep service + standby phone ensures smooth communication.
Users can choose and book mobile protection plans tailored to their needs.
Offers free pick-up and delivery for mobile repairs, enhancing convenience.
Ensures the use of authentic parts for all repairs, maintaining device integrity.
Commits to a 10-day repair or replace policy, minimizing downtime for users.
Repairs are conducted by expert technicians within the company's facilities.
Showcases testimonials and feedback, building trust with potential customers.

text: By addressing key development challenges with smart, scalable solutions and focusing on user-first design, Quik-E’s platform now delivers a smooth, transparent mobile repair experience. The site empowers users with intuitive navigation, real-time service updates, and value-driven features like doorstep pickup and a 10-day repair-or-replace promise—building both trust and convenience into every interaction. This thoughtful digital approach ensures Quik-E effectively meets the needs of today’s fast-moving, mobile-first customers.

text: By addressing these challenges with thoughtful solutions and incorporating user-centric features, Shree Parshwnath Colourants' website now effectively showcases its product range, reinforces its brand identity, and delivers a smooth, engaging user experience across devices.

text: The Cruise Holidays, a bespoke travel agency specializing in luxury cruise experiences, needed a refined and engaging digital platform that could reflect the exclusivity and grandeur of its curated cruise packages. The brand aimed to offer a seamless browsing experience, inspire wanderlust, and provide easy access to detailed itineraries, onboard experiences, and booking options.

Pelicans Technologies was selected for our proven ability to design immersive, user-centric digital experiences. Our team delivered a modern, responsive platform that simplifies exploration and booking, enhances user engagement, and reinforces The Cruise Holidays’ position as a premier provider of unforgettable cruise journeys.
After revamping the UI, user engagement skyrocketed, and we saw a big drop in bounce rate. Interactive features and a fun, engaging design kept users around longer, sparking deeper interactions.

items: Customers often take time to decide on cruise bookings due to high costs and longer travel durations. This results in a lengthy sales funnel.
Cruise bookings involve multiple variables (itineraries, cabins, dining, shore excursions), which can overwhelm users during online browsing.
Unlike tangible products, selling the “experience” of a cruise online requires a rich, immersive presentation, which can be limited by poor design.
Users often struggle to find the most relevant cruises suited to their travel preferences, destinations, or budgets.
Many users browse on mobile, but older site designs are often not fully optimized, leading to drop-offs.
Users may hesitate to make costly cruise bookings online without speaking to a representative or getting personalized assistance.
Optimized booking funnel with clear steps, filters, and options to simplify complex cruise searches, making the process intuitive.
High-quality imagery, videos, and destination highlights to convey the luxury and uniqueness of cruise holidays.
Suggest cruises based on browsing behavior, previous inquiries, travel dates, and destination preferences.
Build trust with real-time assistance and easy options to speak to a travel expert before booking.
Rebuilt the website using a mobile-optimized Shopify theme to ensure seamless experiences across devices.
Implemented email signups, Facebook Pixel, and Google Ads tracking to retarget visitors and nurture leads.
Sophisticated and user-friendly theme reflecting the elegance and class of premium cruise holidays.
Dynamic cruise search filters by destination, price, duration, cruise line, and departure port to help users narrow down quickly.
Cruise videos, image galleries, and 360° cabin views to immerse users in the experience.
Live chat and WhatsApp integration for quick customer support and human interaction during key decision moments.
Mobile-optimized booking interface ensuring ease of navigation and quick actions on phones and tablets.
Personalized email journeys with segmented campaigns based on browsing history, inquiry forms, or abandoned bookings.
Trust-building elements – Cruise reviews, testimonials, badges (e.g., ABTA, ATOL), and clear refund/guarantee policies.
"Plan My Cruise” form, downloadable brochures, and newsletters to capture and nurture potential buyers.

text: The redevelopment of The Cruise Holidays website focused on creating a seamless, inspiring, and conversion-driven experience for travelers seeking luxury cruise vacations. The result is a user-friendly and mobile-optimized destination that builds trust, captures leads, and simplifies the complex cruise booking journey, helping the brand grow its online presence, improve inquiries, and attract a wider audience of discerning travelers.

Pelicans Technologies was brought on board for our proven ability to create compelling, high-performance digital platforms. We designed and developed a sleek, animated, user-centric website for Waterbox that reflects the brand’s clean, modern aesthetic.

The modernized UI resulted in higher user engagement and a significant decrease in the bounce rate. Interactive features and a captivating design held users’ attention, promoting longer visits and enhanced interactions.

items: Ensuring the website loads quickly to prevent user frustration and reduce bounce rates.
As the number and intricacy of animations increase, managing the codebase can become challenging. Keeping track of timelines, tweens, and event listeners requires a well-structured approach.
Providing a consistent user experience across various web browsers to reach a wider audience.
Encouraging visitors to take actions such as subscribing, purchasing, or becoming resellers.
Optimize assets and implement performance-enhancing techniques.​
Utilized GSAP’s Timeline feature to sequence and control multiple animations as a single unit. Break down complex animations into smaller, reusable functions or components.
Implement responsive design principles and test the website across multiple browsers.
Design intuitive and persuasive user interfaces with clear calls-to-action (CTAs).
The site emphasizes the environmental benefits of their WaterBox packaging, highlighting aspects like reduced CO2 emissions and the use of recyclable materials.
Detailed descriptions of their product range, including 250 ml, 500 ml, and 1000 ml cartons of natural spring water, are provided to inform potential customers.
The website incorporates high-quality scroll animation to showcase the products and their eco-friendly packaging, enhancing the overall user experience.
Users interested in regular deliveries or business partnerships can access dedicated sections for subscriptions and reseller applications, facilitating engagement with the brand.

text: By addressing these challenges with thoughtful solutions and integrating purpose-driven, user-friendly features, Waterbox's website successfully communicates its eco-conscious mission while delivering a seamless and engaging digital experience. The platform not only educates users about sustainable hydration but also inspires action—whether it's making a purchase, subscribing, or joining the movement toward a plastic-free future.
